domain: A national retailer that sells through three channels: physical stores, a mail-order catalog, and a website. The warehouse holds sales, returns and inventory facts plus customer, product, time and location dimensions.
rules: Total sales across ALL channels: aggregate each sales table separately and combine with UNION ALL (or join pre-aggregated results). Never join store_sales, catalog_sales and web_sales directly.

Link a return to its sale: store_returns ON (sr_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND sr_ticket_number = ss_ticket_number); catalog_returns ON (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND cr_order_number = cs_order_number); web_returns ON (wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND wr_order_number = ws_order_number).
Filter or group by time by joining the fact's *_date_sk to date_dim.d_date_sk and using d_year / d_moy / d_qoy. Don't do date arithmetic on surrogate keys.
Demographics at purchase time come from the fact row (ss_cdemo_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk); a customer's CURRENT profile comes from customer.c_current_*_sk.
Catalog and web sales have separate bill_* (purchaser) and ship_* (recipient) customer keys; use bill_* for 'who bought'.
Relative dates ('last year', 'this quarter', 'recently') are relative to the latest date in the data, not today's date. See data coverage.
Some fact rows have NULL foreign keys; inner joins drop them, which is usually what's wanted.
Item has multiple versions per product: count distinct i_item_id (not i_item_sk) for number of products.

metrics.revenue: SUM({p}_net_paid). Net sales after coupons, excluding tax and shipping.
metrics.orders: COUNT(DISTINCT {p}_ticket_number) for store_sales; COUNT(DISTINCT {p}_order_number) for catalog/web.
metrics.return_rate: returned units / sold units for the same channel and period.

tables.name: store_sales
tables.description: One row per item on an in-store purchase receipt. The largest fact table.

columns.name: ss_ticket_number
columns.description: Store receipt number; groups line items bought in one store visit.

columns.name: ss_quantity
columns.description: Number of units sold on this line item.

columns.name: ss_wholesale_cost
columns.description: Unit cost the retailer paid for the item.

columns.name: ss_list_price
columns.description: Unit list (sticker) price before any discount.

columns.name: ss_sales_price
columns.description: Unit price actually charged after discount.

columns.name: ss_ext_discount_amt
columns.description: Total discount on the line = (list_price - sales_price) x quantity.

columns.name: ss_ext_sales_price
columns.description: Gross sales amount for the line = sales_price x quantity. "Gross sales".

columns.name: ss_ext_wholesale_cost
columns.description: Total cost of goods for the line = wholesale_cost x quantity.

columns.name: ss_ext_tax
columns.description: Sales tax charged on the line.

columns.name: ss_coupon_amt
columns.description: Coupon discount applied to the line.

columns.name: ss_net_paid
columns.description: Net revenue = ext_sales_price - coupon_amt. Use for "revenue" / "net sales".
